entries.reason: No patched release exists: the advisory covers braces <=3.0.3 and 3.0.3 is the newest version published (first_patched_version is null). In client/ and server/ production trees braces is reached only through patch-package -> find-yarn-workspace-root -> micromatch, which runs at install time over this repository's own patches/ directory and workspace config, never over user input, and it is not part of the browser bundle or the server's runtime code. Upgrade as soon as a fixed braces (or a micromatch that drops it) is published. Re-checked 2026-10-06: braces 3.0.3 is still the newest release and the advisory still lists no patched version; micromatch 4.0.8 (latest) still depends on braces ^3.0.3 and find-yarn-workspace-root 2.0.0 (latest) on micromatch ^4.0.2.
